sentences.text: The genus Anaerococcus was proposed in a reclassification of species of Peptostreptococcus found by 16S rDNA sequence similarity to be distantly related to that genus's type species.
Its species are saccharolytic and butyrate-producing, and include the type species Anaerococcus prevotii together with A. tetradius, A. lactolyticus, A. hydrogenalis, A. vaginalis and A. octavius.

In a survey of anaerobic bacteria from clinical specimens in three Warsaw hospitals, skin and soft tissue specimens yielded the most isolates, with Anaerococcus vaginalis among the predominant species.
A study that profiled diabetes-related foot ulcers by shotgun metagenomic sequencing reported that infection onset was accompanied by increases in obligate anaerobes including Anaerococcus species.
